subject.title: feat: add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently own opt-in per-agent spend-alert configuration and durable alert delivery, or should this capability wait for a generic extension seam?
rationale: The implementation is a new public configuration and persisted-state product contract, not a repair to an established behavior; choosing core ownership versus an extensibility path requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the core contract
options.body: Accept the per-agent configuration and durable SQLite alert semantics as supported core behavior, then complete normal merge and upgrade review.

options.title: Design a generic extension seam
options.body: Pause this branch and first define a plugin-facing usage-accounting and safe-notification seam so optional billing policy can live outside core.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open without merging this branch until a maintainer prioritizes the operator workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core contract
recommendation.body: Accept the per-agent configuration and durable SQLite alert semantics as supported core behavior, then complete normal merge and upgrade review.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only concrete participant connected to both the linked proposal and implementation in the supplied history; maintainer sponsorship remains required.
